ValidationRule.description: Throws error if the Case Record Type is ATM Dispute or Card Dispute and not in Card Disputes - General Queue or Card Disputes - Fraud Queue.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ISCHANGED(OwnerId), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ATM_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute'), AND( NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Card Dispute - General Queue'), NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Card Dispute - Fraud Queue')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For ATM or Card record types, please select either Card Disputes - General Queue or Card Disputes - Fraud Queue.
